content.comment_body: Is it possible to use different voltage levels with an analog expansion module? For example, a 230Vac CPU together with an analog module powered by a 24Vdc power supply and then a digital input/output module running at 24Vdc. Thank you in advance, [user_name].
Hello [user_name], have you already checked this thread? You can follow advice from experts here: [url]
Refer to the manual, chapter 2.1.3 for the setup with various voltage classes. You can download it from: [url]

I had a similar issue recently. I found that there is a plastic piece preventing the connection of high-voltage expansion modules to low-voltage mains modules. Out of necessity, I removed the plastic part and connected it; surprisingly, it worked without issues. However, I understand that [company_name] would not officially support this method.

Hi, if you perform this modification, you create an electrical isolation problem. The analog expansion module has internal electrical isolation, so using it one way is permitted, but according to the manual, the other direction is not allowed. If problems occur later, you are responsible. That is why the plastic coding exists.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are discussing the feasibility and safety of running modular [company_name] hardware with different voltage types.
